experiment_data.hypothesis: Removing domain-specific features (dataset_enc, entity_type distributions) forces the verifier to rely on domain-invariant signals, improving cross-domain generalization at the cost of some discriminative power. If LGB AUC improves on held-out domains, domain features were causing negative transfer.

metrics.verdict: LGB AUC improved by removing domain features, confirming negative transfer. But ECE still high, F1 delta still negative.
